title: #18 Matt Neal, Pyramid Motorsport BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Medium confidence. 2026-11-16: side redrawn from a left-side photo of Neal's #18 at round 7 (Silverstone GP, his BTCC debut): supertouring.co.uk 1991 entrants gallery page 3, 'neal_91.jpg', credited (c) www.mattneal.co.uk (https://web.archive.org/web/2012/http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991_entrants_3.html, image http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991/neal_91.jpg, 230x160, saved in teams/Pyramid Motorsport/ask_permission/on_track). Near side-on, so positions were scaled from the wheel centres. It shows: dark body down to the sill (no yellow band on the doors), yellow only on the front and rear bumpers, blue sill band with H & J SPEAKE in white; 'aluminium' (small, white) and a big light blue VAW on the front wing; ESSO board with 18 at the front of the door; a big red 100+ with a white edge and WHEELS under it on the door; YOKOHAMA in white with the red Y chevron, then British Gas (light blue) and RESOURCE (red) on the rear quarter; Neal in white on the rear side window; gold mesh wheels with polished lips. No Shell roundel on this side at round 7, so it was removed. The small white stickers behind the front wheel and above 100+ are unreadable and not drawn. Rear view (Getty LAT 2201221866): British Gas and Resource on the rear screen, Cosack (UK) Ltd and Taco on the boot. Body colour kept as the very dark blue of the Fenwick photo (Super Touring Register 6216); in the Neal photo it reads black. Logos: real Yokohama wordmark and chevron; the rest stays lettering (no VAW, 100+ Wheels, Speake or Resource logo; the saved British Gas logo has the flame roundel, which this photo does not show clearly).
